meta.scope: Chile batch 1 — Phase 0+1. Core national statistical system from INE Chile catalogue top-down: national accounts, CPI, labour (ENE), poverty measurement framework, population, central bank anchors, and foundational statistical coordination. Definition locked.

candidates.title: Instituto Nacional de Estadísticas (INE) — institutional statistical identity
candidates.publisher: Instituto Nacional de Estadísticas de Chile
candidates.description: National statistical office of Chile. Produces the core official statistics (prices, employment, industrial production, population projections, etc.) and coordinates the national statistical system.
referenced_by: All major INE programme methodologies and press releases
Banco Central de Chile statistical publications that cite INE sources
Ministry of Social Development poverty methodology documents
candidates.notes: Institutional parent node for Chilean official statistics. Continuously cited as the producer of the principal economic and social series.

candidates.title: Índice de Precios al Consumidor (IPC) / Consumer Price Index
candidates.description: Monthly consumer price index measuring changes in the prices of a representative basket of goods and services of urban households. Geographic coverage: regional capitals and conurbations. Base currently 2023=100; next base change planned for 2028 after the 10th EPF.
candidates.notes: Flagship price statistic. Published on the 8th of each month (or previous business day). Directly used by the Banco Central de Chile for inflation monitoring and for the UF/UTM adjustment mechanisms. July 2026 monthly variation 0.1%.

candidates.title: Encuesta Nacional de Empleo (ENE) / National Employment Survey
candidates.description: Continuous household survey producing the official labour-market indicators: employment, unemployment, labour force participation, informal employment, and related rates. Published as moving quarters.
candidates.notes: Core labour survey. April–June 2026: national unemployment rate 9.4%; informal employment rate 27.0%. Microdata and detailed tables released regularly. Experimental dimensions (skill mismatch, etc.) recently added.

candidates.title: Cuentas Nacionales / National Accounts of Chile
candidates.publisher: Banco Central de Chile (with INE source data)
candidates.description: Full system of national accounts producing GDP by production, expenditure and income, institutional sector accounts and related aggregates. Compiled by the Central Bank; many volume and price inputs from INE.
candidates.notes: In Chile the central bank is the primary compiler of the national accounts, using extensive INE source statistics. Quarterly GDP and annual institutional accounts are the headline products.

candidates.title: Índice de Producción Industrial (IPI) / Industrial Production Index
candidates.description: Monthly volume index of industrial production (manufacturing, mining, electricity/gas/water). Principal short-term activity indicator for the industrial sector.
candidates.notes: Core short-term industrial indicator. May 2026: +1.6% year-on-year. Complements the broader activity measures produced by the Central Bank.

candidates.title: Medición de la pobreza por ingresos / Income poverty measurement
candidates.publisher: Ministerio de Desarrollo Social y Familia + INE + CEPAL technical support
candidates.description: Official income-poverty measurement based on a basic food basket and non-food component, updated with methodological revisions (most recent major update process 2025). Uses household survey income data and IPC for price updating.
candidates.notes: Headline social indicator. Methodology recently reviewed with CEPAL, INE and MDSF participation. Canasta Básica de Alimentos constructed from the EPF and updated with IPC food prices.

candidates.title: Encuesta de Presupuestos Familiares (EPF) / Family Budget Survey
candidates.description: Periodic household expenditure survey that supplies the weights and basket for the CPI and is a key input into the poverty-line construction. 10th round scheduled 2026–2027 for the 2028 CPI base change.
candidates.notes: Structural survey underpinning both the CPI and the poverty methodology. Next round (10ª EPF) begins collection September 2026 and will drive the 2028=100 CPI base.

candidates.title: Censo de Población y Vivienda / Population and Housing Census
candidates.description: Decennial population and housing census. Provides the demographic baseline and sampling frames for household surveys. Latest major census 2017; next cycle in preparation.
candidates.notes: Foundational demographic product. Population projections and survey designs continuously reference the census baseline.

candidates.title: Banco Central de Chile — statistical publications (monetary, external, national accounts)
candidates.description: Central-bank statistical output covering monetary aggregates, balance of payments, international reserves, exchange rates, and the compilation of the national accounts.
candidates.notes: In the Chilean division of labour the Central Bank is the primary compiler of national accounts and the producer of the core external and monetary statistics, while INE supplies the price, labour and many volume indicators.

candidates.title: Indicador de Actividad Económica Regional (INACER)
candidates.description: Regional economic activity indicator produced by INE for the regions of Chile. Provides a geographic disaggregation of short-term activity.
candidates.notes: Regional counterpart to the national activity measures. Useful for the later regional/metro hierarchy fill.

proposed_edges.basis: IPC is produced and disseminated by INE.
ENE is the flagship labour survey of INE.
Poverty-line construction uses the EPF for the structure of the basic food basket.
Poverty lines are updated with IPC food and non-food price indices.
National accounts are compiled by the Banco Central de Chile.
EPF supplies the expenditure weights and basket that define the CPI structure.
